linework.observation: Strong continuous outlines define the bald protagonist, pump, pipes, table and handset.

colour.observation: Muted steel, navy, cream and dusty blue, with restrained blue bands on pipes.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows and simplified metal highlights.

character_construction.observation: The protagonist has the canonical rounded bald head, full face and coherent proportions.

backgrounds.observation: Dense enclosed machinery bay with pumps and gauges, no exterior openings.

finish.observation: Crisp, polished illustration with clear equipment detail.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls remain consistent.

content.observation: Handset and maintenance/log table fit a watch in the machinery space.

composition.observation: Full-body wide frame with clear headroom and orderly equipment depth.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist listening on a handset.
regions.foreground_props: Handset, chart papers and log table.
regions.architecture: Pump, valves, gauges, pipework and sealed passage.
regions.distance: Equipment runs recede down the narrow compartment.
regions.lighting: Cream overhead lights with muted steel and blue tones.
